_desc: Fill every field. Remove all _desc fields from your output. See GENERATION_GUIDE.md for rules. Coordinates are integers in meters. World is 3000x3000 km = 0–3,000,000 per axis.

starting_state.location_scene_id: string — scene id where a new playthrough begins

constants._desc: Layer A — always injected into every LLM prompt. ~200 tokens. World tone, era, cosmology, current global political situation in one paragraph.

realms._desc: A kingdom, empire, or major political entity. Spans hundreds of km. Repeat for each realm.
realms.name: string
realms.government_type: string — e.g. empire / kingdom / city-state-league / clan-confederation / theocracy
realms.description: string — 2–3 sentences: political character, dominant culture, current situation.

bounding_box._desc: Approximate extent of realm's territorial claim in meters.

regions._desc: Layer B scope. A geographic sub-division of the realm. 80–100 km across. Repeat for each region.
regions.name: string
regions.climate: string — e.g. subarctic / temperate / arid / tropical / mediterranean
regions.layer_b_text: string — ~300 tokens. Climate, culture, factions, political tension, geography. Do not repeat realm-level info.

city_areas._desc: An urban settlement and its immediate surroundings. Up to 10 km across. Repeat for each city/town/village in this region.
city_areas.name: string
city_areas.size: string — e.g. village / town / city / capital

zones._desc: Layer C scope — a district, neighborhood, or named area within the city. 1–3 km across.
zones.name: string
zones.type: string — e.g. market-district / docks / noble-quarter / slums / temple-district / guild-row
zones.layer_c_text: string — ~200 tokens. Local character, current situation, who lives here, landmarks.

scenes._desc: Layer D scope — a specific building, street, square, or outdoor spot.
scenes.name: string
scenes.type: string — e.g. tavern / market / alley / gate / shrine / shop / barracks / square
scenes.layer_d_text: string — ~200 tokens. Physical description, light, smell, sound, ambient mood. No game mechanics.

group_entries.label: string — short identifier e.g. corner drinkers
group_entries.description: string — one sentence of sensory/behavioral detail

sub_scenes._desc: Rooms or sections within this scene. Optional.
sub_scenes.name: string
sub_scenes.layer_d_text: string — ~100 tokens. More specific than parent scene.

wilderness_zones._desc: Layer C scope — non-urban zones in this region: forests, ruins, roads, dungeons, passes. Same structure as city zones but no city_area parent.
wilderness_zones.name: string
wilderness_zones.type: string — e.g. forest / ruin / road / dungeon / mountain-pass / coast / marsh

static_npcs._desc: Pre-authored World-Scoped NPCs. Distribute across scenes via schedule. Repeat for each.
static_npcs.name: string
static_npcs.role: string — social/political role e.g. town guard captain, merchant guild head
static_npcs.description: string — appearance and immediate impression in 2–3 sentences
static_npcs.personality: string — 2–3 dominant traits, how they speak and behave

schedule.scene_id: string — must match a scene id defined above

static_npcs.knowledge: string — what this NPC knows: world facts, faction secrets, local information. Used by LLM for consistent dialogue.
